teacher_objective: q=softmax(exp(logit_scale)*similarity), p=softmax(-stored-unit arm6 MSE/training_tau), loss=-sum(p log q); logit_scale is learned, initialized at 1/.07 and capped at 100.
hard_control: e_vlm_h-hard: one argmin-arm6-MSE positive per candidate set (hard InfoNCE)

memory_key_fields: stored decoded unit actions only for separate-key control
e_h.training_self_episode_exclusion: task/episode IDs are used only to mask same-episode memory candidates when forming memory-side training batches; they are not model inputs.
e_h.evaluation_labels: used only for metrics and Dev-only configuration selection; learned/unseen query episodes are asserted absent from the candidate pool.
